description_expanded: OverviewSpacious Cottage-3 Bikes-Huge open living area, Community Pool/Heated Seasonally - Private Beach- 5 Minute Bike RideThe Space QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: 3 Adult Bikes Included – Explore 30A with ease Private, Gated Community – Parks, trails & boardwalks Private Beach Access – Scenic boardwalk stroll to sugar-white sands Zero-Entry Community Pool – Heated seasonally w/ cabanas, outdoor grill & fireplace Gas Grill & Outdoor Living – Perfect for al fresco dining Fiberoptic Internet & Wi-Fi – Stay connected & stream with ease Spacious Open Floor Plan – Coastal charm & modern design throughout Chef’s Kitchen – Stainless steel appliances, gas range, & wine cooler Screened-In Back Porch – Enjoy your morning coffee or an evening meal Driveway Parking for 2 Cars – Hassle-free & convenient Only 3.5 Miles to Seaside & 5 Miles to Rosemary Beach – Close to dining & shopping Professionally Managed, 24/7 Service – Stress-free vacation planningWelcome to Sandpiper CottageSandpiper Cottage is a spacious cottage home located in Watersound West in the Seacrest Beach area of 30A. Boasting 3 bedrooms plus a bunk room, this “cottage” actually sleeps 8 guests! Upon entering the huge open living area, you’ll be taken aback by the amount of space from the comfortable seating area and large flatscreen tv, leading into the dining and kitchen areas. Gleaming hardwood floors are throughout the space. The kitchen is a chef’s dream, featuring stainless steel appliances, gas range, huge island with pendant lighting with seating for 4 and a wine cooler. The dining table is just to the side under a statement piece chandelier and seats 6. The main level also features the Master bedroom with King bed and en suite bath. Upstairs with more gleaming hardwood floors, you’ll find a Queen guest room with en suite bath, another Queen bedroom, and a bunk room the kids will adore behind sliding barn doors with Twin bunk beds. Outside the back door is a deep screened-in porch in which to enjoy an evening dinner or morning coffee. A quick 5-minute stroll down the neighborhood street will take you to Watersound’s awesome pool complex, with grilling and dining areas. Make the most of your vacation time and see why Sandpiper Cottage is a family favorite!House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (8):1st floor - Master - King bed with en suite bath2nd floor - Guest - Queen bed with en suite bath2nd floor - Guest - Queen bed with shared bathroom2nd Floor - Bunk - Twin over twin bunk, shared bathroom** Bicycles ARE allowed in the WaterSoundWest community on the streets. Due to safety and legal concerns, the WaterSoundWest HOA will no longer allow bicycles on the West Beach boardwalks. However, they are still permitted on the beach walkover, with the following provisions. (1) Bicycles must be walked from where the pavement ends at the clubhouse to the entrance of the beach walkover, where the railing begins; and (2) Bicycles must be ridden at the lowest possible speed while on the beach walkover. *****Watersound West HOA does not allow golf carts in this community***AREA ATTRACTIONS:“The Hub” is the community center for Prominence and is a quick 10-minute bike ride your home or 1.6-mile drive. The Hub offers something for folks of all ages and tastes, from tacos and tequila, to wings, burgers and shakes, a stop here is quick, tasty and convenient, and comes with a side of entertainment at the outdoor amphitheater. It's a great place to catch a concert, sporting event, or a movie on the lawn.Seaside is a short drive away and is most widely known for being featured in the Truman Show featuring Jim Carrey. Its incredible architecture has helped to make it famous but also its faithful replication of the kind of seaside town that used to be common up and down the coast. Seaside has its own Farmer's Market, post office, Repertory Theater and neighborhood school. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture that makes Seaside famous. There are activities for everyone: kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here.Families will love the amazing amenities at WaterSound West! This 256-acre, gated community is ideally located directly on the Gulf of Mexico between Seaside and Rosemary Beach. The zero-entry neighborhood pool features cabanas, outdoor grills and a fireplace! Go exploring on boardwalks & nature trails that wind through the community, over the large pond, and directly to the Beach. With Horseshoe Park & Deer Lake State Park nearby, a 9-hole putt-putt course, bike and kayak rentals available, WaterSound West is sure be the perfect peaceful beach vacation!Show less
